Hi Maya / Paul —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and I attached the SOW draft + pricing sheet for line items. High level below; happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through numbers.

Audit log retention (per-GB/month, USD) — tiered:
- 90 days: $0.008/GB/mo
- 365 days: $0.015/GB/mo
- 730 days: $0.022/GB/mo
Notes: These include compressed store + basic index. Longer retention can be set per workspace; we can mix tiers by prefix.

HSM seat pooling:
- Seat pooling lets you allocate a pool of N logical HSM seats that can be used by any region in your account; physical HSM usage is kept within the region for legal requirements.
- Failover: if a regional node fails, keys are temporarily served from a warm replica in an adjacent region (no extra seat charges during 72-hr failover window); longer failovers use pooled seats from your pool.
- Isolation: for HIPAA workloads you can opt to pin a subset of seats to a region (no pooling) — that reduces flexibility but ensures strict residency.

Evidence/SOC2: attaching a sanitized SOC2 evidence sample (redacted). We typically provide an evidence bundle within 10 business days of a signed SOW for onboarding audits; continuous evidence exports can be scheduled monthly.

Pilot concession option: we can offer a 40% discount on HSM seat list rate for a 3-month pilot, in exchange for a 12-month conversion at a 6-month trailing-commit (i.e., you commit to a minimum monthly spend after conversion). Exact numbers in the attached pricing sheet.

Attachments: SOW_ArborWell_v1.2.pdf (Draft SOW), HSM_seat_pricing_sheet.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_sample.zip

Proposed next step: 30-min call Thurs or Fri to run through the SOW and redlines. What times work?

— Hiro

Hiro / Lauren —

Numbers below are authorized by pricing. Kept the pilot simple and gave two conversion routes to keep procurement flexibility.

Pilot (preferred):
- Duration: 3 months
- Auditlog: 90-day tier at $0.0048/GB/mo (60% of list) for the pilot only
- HSM seats: up to 3 pooled seats at $950/seat/mo (40% off list $1,583)
- Ingest cap: discounted rates apply up to 4TB/mo; incremental overage at list rates
- Evidence SLA: onboarding evidence bundle delivery within 7 business days (10bd is standard; we can accelerate to 5bd only with an escrow fee to cover ops).

Conversion options (if they sign to 12-month commit within 30 days of pilot end):
Option A — Throughput commit:
- $75k/mo committed: 10% discount on usage
- $150k/mo committed: 18% discount on usage + 2 reserved HSM seats included
- $300k/mo committed: 25% discount on usage + 4 reserved HSM seats + priority support
Option B — Seat-heavy commit:
- Seat-anchored: buy N reserved seats at a reduced capitalized price; auditlog billed at list less committed discount ladder above

Legal/compliance flags:
- Evidence SLA: ops can do 7bd without a fee; 5bd requires an implementation uplift to cover engineers and evidence curation — suggest charging a one-time $12k acceleration fee or accepting standard 10bd.
- Insurance/liability: procurement will push for increased caps; standard Redwood commercial terms apply — for larger commits we can table SLA credits up to 10% of monthly invoice.
- Residency pinning: pinning seats to a region removes pooling flexibility and requires a 20% premium on seat pricing due to capacity reservation.

If Hiro wants to be aggressive to close the deal, authorize pilot concession as above and give procurement a DocuSign SOW link with the pilot pricing. I'll draft the exact DocuSign payload if you confirm.
